description: Create a DRAFT campaign for a whole list of recipients in one call. This does NOT deliver anything and does NOT count against the plan's monthly send quota. Every recipient gets their own individual email when it is sent (never a shared To/CC), each with its own unsubscribe link. Pass `recipients` as an array of addresses, or `contactListId` to use a saved contact list. Duplicates are removed, anyone who has unsubscribed from this workspace is stored as `skipped` and will not be mailed, and undeliverable addresses are dropped. Returns the campaign id and a `campaignUrl` that opens it in Bottled's web UI for review. Call send_campaign once the user approves.

contactListId.description: Saved contact list to mail instead of an explicit recipients array

from.description: Sender address on a verified domain the workspace owns, e.g. hello@yourdomain.com. Defaults to the workspace's primary address.

name.description: Internal campaign name, shown in the dashboard

recipients.description: Recipient addresses, one individual email each

name: create_campaign
